Logistics support specialist 
 What we expect: 
 You speak and write English well; Dutch is a plus 
 Ideally you have experience in logistics, customer service or another support role 
 You are a natural investigator and don't let go of a case until you know what happened 
 You work in a structured way and keep the overview, even when many emails come in at once 
 You communicate clearly and kindly with customers and carriers 
 You don't mind lending a hand on the warehouse floor 
 What we offer: 
 A permanent job at Hartevelt, 40 hours a week 
 Job description 
Every day, large numbers of parcels leave Hartevelt for the customers of the fashion brands we work for. Sometimes something goes wrong along the way. A box doesn't arrive or a delivery is incomplete, and our client wants to know quickly what happened. Because we hold the contracts with the carriers, we are responsible for that support. As logistics support specialist, you are the link between our clients, our packing department and carriers such as DHL, DPD and UPS. You investigate, liaise with everyone involved and make sure every case is properly closed. You can start right away, or later by agreement. 
Tasks and responsibilities: - You handle the daily emails from clients about short deliveries and missing boxes - For each case, you work with the carrier (DHL, DPD or UPS) to find out what happened - You check with the packing department how a shipment was processed and sent - You keep the client informed about the progress and the outcome - You work closely with the packing department supervisor - Where needed, you take on other tasks on the warehouse floor 
 About Hartevelt 
Hartevelt Fashion Fulfilment is a family business that started in 1945 as a dry cleaner in Zeist. Four generations later, we are a full service fulfilment partner for fashion brands. From our warehouse of more than 21,000 m² in De Meern, we handle the complete logistics process: goods receipt, order ...

You will work in a dynamic environment where teamwork, safety, and quality are key. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that incoming and outgoing goods are handled efficiently, enabling customers around the world to receive their products on time.

You are someone who enjoys rolling up your sleeves and thrives in a dynamic work environment. In addition:

- You have experience as a logistics employee
- You are available full-time (40 hours per week)
